published.text: Model-classified claim (not independently verified): the Workspace Curator Addon computes only classification and briefing, while the MASC host retains durable fact intake, original request identity, memory ledger commits, observer acknowledgements, and effect authority. Consistent with this boundary, a repaired isolated Curator host completed the originally retained Briefing while the installation was Off, preserved the classification receipt and Keeper memory, and published the matching observer acknowledgement without recreating the worker — showing that disabling the Curator installation preserves pending original work so it can be reattached. Constraints from these claims: disabling must preserve pending original work, and re-enabling the installation must keep those original results immutable while processing newly admitted facts separately. No conflicts or corrections exist yet; later batches may extend this briefing.
